notes: Single thick frame rule on all sides. Each side's inner edge was measured column by column wherever paper lies inside the rule, smoothed with a robust local-linear fit, and the outline set ~1.5 px inside it (the first clean paper row; README rule 1), points every ~50-250 px; corners where the fitted sides meet. Where street lines run into the rule, the outline crosses them at the rule's inner edge (kind b); the rest of the little ink left under the outline is single specks by the rule. The bottom side is the top edge of the thick bar that rules off the legend/title strip (rule 3), so the strip is outside; the north arrow and scale bar sit in that strip, so there is no remove polygon. Page turned about 0.8 degrees; corners where they are (rule 7). No holes (rule 4): 'SEE SHEET 6' (top), 'SEE SHEET 13' (left, vertical) and 'SEE SHEET 11' (right, vertical) are floating cross-references with no box, so they are inside. No SECTION badge on this sheet (the sheet number is in the legend strip). 'COUNTY LINE' (bottom right) labels the county line and is map.
drawn_by: Claude, by eye on full-resolution crops, 2026-11-19; holes added 2026-11-20 (floating blocks are frame); 2026-11-20 (owner rule changes): holes removed (cross-references are floating text, inside), sides refitted onto the rule's inner edge from measured column profiles
